english.note: Use this when presenting an additional, separate point or item rather than simply adding emphasis to the same point.
Use this when introducing a separate additional point, roughly “besides” or “additionally.”

examples.english: Additionally, we need to prepare another document.
examples.traditional: 另外，我哋要準備多一份文件。
examples.jyutping: ling6 ngoi6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 do1 jat1 fan6 man4 gin6

examples.english: Furthermore, it will rain tomorrow, so remember to bring an umbrella.
examples.traditional: 另外，聽日會落雨，記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping: ling6 ngoi6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1
